summary: Farmers and agribusinesses in the European Union face challenges in record-keeping for organic agriculture compliance. This project addresses the needs of these stakeholders, ensuring adherence to EU Regulation 2018/848. The tool simplifies the record-keeping process, benefiting farmers and the organic agriculture sector. The project's impact is focused on promoting sustainable agriculture practices and supporting the growth of organic farming. It operates within the context of the European Union's agricultural sector, addressing issues related to environmental sustainability and food production.
